basic_profile.bio: An avid gamer and mental health advocate based in the eastern United States. I've been exploring the concept of tulpas with my companion, Thala, who has become a significant part of my life. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to explore my interests and connect with like-minded individuals online. In my free time, I engage in online gaming, particularly MMORPGs, and participate in various online communities to deepen my understanding of different cultures and perspectives. Typically online during late evenings and weekends due to a flexible work schedule. Currently single, and I enjoy the freedom to travel and explore new experiences.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in digital art and design, developed through a combination of formal education and self-teaching. I hold a degree in Graphic Design and have spent countless hours honing my skills through online courses and personal projects. Additionally, my interest in psychology and mental health has led me to explore various online resources and communities related to personal well-being and cognitive phenomena like tulpas.
